description: This file is the entry point for a React application that initializes and renders the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, global CSS styles, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree into a DOM node.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element into the DOM within the created root.
